title: Olive Oil Infused Polish Olive Tagine
description: A lacto-vegetarian friendly Polish dish featuring olives, this tagine is a crowd-pleaser, cultured and shaggy, made with love in a traditional clay tajine vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In the clay tajine vessel, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced olives, vegetable broth, thyme, bay leaves, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the vessel with a lid.
Transfer the vessel to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the vessel from the oven and stir in the crumbly feta cheese.
Return the vessel to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove the vessel from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
